name: Yassamin Ansari
stance: Frames frontier AI as a catastrophic and national-security risk requiring arms-control-style international guardrails; led the House letter demanding the administration negotiate AI global-security rules, and has called for a pause on advanced AI development and a ban on artificial superintelligence as a day-one Democratic priority.

statements.text: Top of the Democratic agenda on day 1 needs to be a pause on advanced AI development, regulation of this out of control industry, and a ban on artificial superintelligence.
The fact that Congress remains out of session as unauthorized AI agents are hacking major U.S. banks is INSANE.
Called for an immediate pause on advanced AI development after reports of unauthorized AI agents acting inside U.S. bank customer accounts.
Donald Trump is wrong and AI companies cannot self-regulate. We need urgent and bipartisan AI regulation from Congress.
Just as we regulate airplanes, pharmaceutical drugs, cars and nuclear weapons, we need guardrails on advanced AI and we must ban artificial superintelligence - urgently.
We’ve been warned repeatedly that frontier AI poses an existential threat to humanity. The companies themselves are preparing for it. Congress and the President need to act now.
No country can fight this alone. The U.S. and China must cooperate on AI security now, before our financial system is next.
Shared a report that three AI safety researchers who left OpenAI had previously expressed safety concerns publicly, calling it important.
It is the government’s job to regulate industry — especially frontier AI that has the capacity to harm human beings at a massive scale.
Urged President Trump to reject AI industry self-policing and to lead negotiations with China on global rules for AI.
Welcomed a report that OpenAI co-founder Greg Brockman dropped a promised second $25 million donation to the super PAC Leading the Future ("This is good. And we need more of it.").
we need enforceable rules on advanced AI that hold these billionaire executives accountable—before it's too late.

Proud to be among the first supporters of @RepCasar's critical bill to ban superintelligence and pause advanced AI development. Congressional Republicans need to return to work immediately and put this bill up for a vote.
It is imperative that Speaker Johnson hold urgent and bipartisan hearings on advanced AI. The CEOs and engineers of these companies should be testifying in front of the American people.
Announced support as one of the first House co-sponsors of Rep. Casar's bill with Sen. Sanders to ban artificial superintelligence.
The administration’s refusal to regulate the AI industry—despite dire warnings about potential threats to the safety of Americans—is all part of the corruption story.

This highly capable, advanced technology could be a threat to all humans. That's why I'm calling on President Trump to work with countries like China to set global rules on the development of Frontier AI.
We need to pause advanced AI, set guardrails, and enact a global framework that protects our national security interests.

Led a House letter, signed by dozens of colleagues, demanding the administration open urgent negotiations with allies and adversaries on AI global security and rules to prevent the proliferation of uncontrollable frontier AI.
True global security in the untested and fast-advancing field of AI requires stability, predictability, and strategic restraint.
It’s outrageous for Republicans to say we can’t regulate AI because we’re not experts.
